blocks.orig: A few kilometres from the bustling centre of Moshi, the Maridadi Hotel is a pleasant and comfortable boutique hotel. The 24 rooms are bright and decorated in earthy colours inspired by African culture. Well equipped with a cosy bed, air conditioning, a fan, TV, and a modern bathroom, each room also has a private balcony. Indulge in a spa treatment, or wander through the lush garden, plunge into the large swimming pool and enjoy the BBQ & Pizza garden restaurant. But you could also decide to head to one of the 3 other restaurants, such as the Kibo Rooftop Lounge which boasts amazing views of Mount Kilimanjaro.
blocks.html: Only a few kilometres outside lively central Moshi, the Maridadi Hotel is a boutique hotel where you can feel comfortable and at ease. There are 24 light-filled rooms in earthy shades inspired by African culture. Every room has its own balcony and comes with air conditioning, a fan, a TV, a modern bathroom and a cosy bed. Book a spa treatment, take a walk in the lush garden, swim in the big pool and have a meal at the BBQ & Pizza garden restaurant. Alternatively, pick one of the 3 other restaurants, for example the Kibo Rooftop Lounge, which has amazing views of Mount Kilimanjaro.
